ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels and 40% low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly white ground with dense, irregular black linear mottling. High-intensity white regions are concentrated in the central areas of both lobes, transitioning to low-intensity black regions along the leading edges and at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a wide vertex angle (~115 degrees) and moderate depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged topography with high-frequency serrations. Distinctive large peaks and valleys (5-15 pixel amplitude) are visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, creating a saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature on the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping outward and upward to heavily textured distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent circular/annular high-contrast white scar visible on the mid-left lobe near the base. Dense 3D clusters of low-intensity, high-texture barnacle colonies at the far distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). These appear as vertical and diagonal black streaks of varying widths covering the majority of the white ventral surface on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe, dense rake marks (likely tooth rakes) covering over 70% of the visible surface. Significant barnacle encrustation on the distal margins, particularly the right tip, which appears heavily thickened and irregular.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of barnacle growth on the distal tips creates a unique, bulbous 'fringed' appearance not common in standard fluke profiles.
